scope: full labeled valid ternary boards whose first nonzero selected pattern difference is role 1
full_count_rule: N=N0+N1+N2+N3, exactly one completed count per branch
original_color_reconstruction: z_cell=a+s*d_cell; d_cell is the exported affine polynomial, so reconstruction can contain a term proportional to s
inverse_reconstruction: a=z_apex; D=z-a; s=Delta_1(D); d=s*D; compute original Gray prefixes; retain exported surviving coordinates and a,s
